label.fa: سرمازدگی شدید بزرگسال (کاهش خطر قطع انگشت) — انفوزیون وریدی ۶ ساعت در روز تا ۸ روز؛ شروع ۰٫۵ نانوگرم/kg/دقیقه
label.en: Severe frostbite in adults (to reduce digit amputation) — IV infusion 6 h daily for up to 8 days; start 0.5 ng/kg/min

reason.fa: هر ۳۰ دقیقه ۰٫۵ نانوگرم/kg/دقیقه افزایش تا حداکثر ۲؛ روز ۲ و ۳ تیتراسیون تکرار؛ از روز ۴ با بالاترین دوز تحمل‌شده. نارسایی متوسط/شدید کبد: شروع ۰٫۲۵. علائم حیاتی پیش و پس از هر افزایش. شکل استنشاقی (Ventavis) برای PAH جداست.
reason.en: Increase by 0.5 ng/kg/min every 30 min to max 2; repeat titration on days 2 and 3; from day 4 start at the highest tolerated rate. Moderate/severe hepatic impairment: start 0.25. Vital signs before and after each increase. Inhaled Ventavis for PAH is a different product.

text.en: Label states no clear risk or has limited data; use only if needed, under medical advice.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary There are no available data with AURLUMYN during pregnancy to evaluate for a drug-associated risk of major birth defects, miscarriage, or adverse maternal or fetal outcomes.

lactation.quote: Because of the potential for serious adverse reactions, advise women not to breastfeed during treatment with iloprost [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5 ) and Adverse Reactions ( 6 )] .

text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: In general, dose selection for an elderly patient should be cautious, usually starting at the low end of the dosing range, reflecting the greater frequency of decreased hepatic, renal, or cardiac function, and of concomitant disease or other drug therapy.
